title: SentinelPAM: Relational Privileged Access Management
relevance: Strongest backend proof for Outbox: relational database modeling in PostgreSQL, low-latency Express REST APIs, and real-time anomaly detection pipelines.
problem: Unmonitored privileged access creates silent security breaches. Needed sub-50ms session verification and real-time anomaly scoring across sensitive administrative operations.
architecture:
Client / Admin Dashboard
  ↓ REST API (JWT + RBAC)
Express.js Gateway (Node.js)
  ├─ Session Authenticator & Token Verifier
  ├─ Audit Log Ingestion Engine
  └─ Anomaly Detection Dispatcher
      ↓
PostgreSQL (Relational Schema: users, roles, sessions, partitioned audit_logs)
      ↕
Python Anomaly Scoring Worker (Real-time Behavioral Analytics)

hardProblem.title: Write Contention & Latency on High-Frequency Audit Ingestion
hardProblem.description: High-volume access events caused database write contention and slow analytical queries. Structured PostgreSQL audit logs with table partitioning by month and composite indexing on (user_id, action_timestamp). Buffered ingestion via batch writes to decouple audit recording from client response latency, achieving sub-50ms verify cycles.

measurableResult: Sub-50ms p95 authorization check latency. TODO: Add exact query throughput or simulated concurrency metrics (e.g. 'Handled 500+ events/sec with zero log loss').

title: CandleCrush: Server-Authoritative Trading Simulator
relevance: Direct stack match for Outbox: Node.js + TypeScript + Express.js backend with React frontend. Demonstrates server-authoritative trade validation and typed API contracts.
problem: Trading education platforms suffer from client-side state manipulation or laggy execution. Needed a server-authoritative engine that validates orders and tracks portfolio balances without desync.
architecture:
React + Tailwind Client (Vite)
  ↓ Typed REST API (Shared TypeScript Interfaces)
Express.js Server (Node.js + TypeScript)
  ├─ Order Validation & Matching Pipeline
  ├─ Balance Lock & Execution Unit
  ├─ Market Tick Simulator
  └─ AI Mentor Logic Handler
      ↓
In-Memory Session Store / State Persistence

hardProblem.title: Concurrency & Balance Race Condition Prevention
hardProblem.description: Rapid market orders triggered simultaneous balance checks before deductions finished. Implemented atomic transaction sequencing on player balance mutations and strict server-side order validation before execution, preventing double-spend exploits and state desynchronization.

measurableResult: Deterministic order execution within 15ms. TODO: Add registered players / game sessions count (e.g. 'Tested over 1,000+ simulated trade runs without balance drift').

title: AtLast: Autonomous Multi-Agent Trivia Engine
relevance: Demonstrates high-throughput backend architecture: Redis predictive caching, async agent validation queue, and sub-second API delivery relevant to Outbox's email pipeline scale.
problem: Static question databases go stale, while on-the-fly multi-agent generation takes 2-4 seconds—ruining real-time interactive game flow.
architecture:
Next.js Frontend (WebSocket + REST)
  ↓ REST API Gateway
FastAPI Gateway Service
  ├─ Redis Predictive Question Queue (Pre-cached by Tier)
  └─ Background Worker Trigger
      ↓ Async Queue
LangGraph Multi-Agent Pipeline (Scraper → Drafter → Adversarial Judge)
      ↓
PostgreSQL (pgvector Embeddings) ← Kubernetes Horizontal Autoscaling

hardProblem.title: Predictive Cache Tiering for Decoupled Multi-Agent Generation
hardProblem.description: Multi-agent generation and LLM-as-judge validation took 3+ seconds per question. Engineered a background worker monitoring Redis queue depth per category/difficulty bucket. The pipeline pre-generates and validates questions ahead of user requests, decoupling expensive generation from API responses and delivering cached questions in under 200ms.

measurableResult: Sub-200ms API response latency from Redis cache. Decoupled 3s async generation pipeline. TODO: Add total questions served or concurrent user metric.
